arxiv-1804-02654.title: Ribbonness of a stable-ribbon surface-link, I. A stably trivial surface-link
arxiv-1804-02654.creator: Akio Kawauchi
arxiv-1804-02654.description: Abstract There is a question asking whether a handle-irreducible summand of every stable-ribbon surface-link is a unique ribbon surface-link. This question for the case of a trivial surface-link is affirmatively answered. That is, a handle-irreducible summand of every stably trivial surface-link is only a trivial 2-link. By combining this result with an old result of F.

arxiv-1912-00289.title: A Programmatic and Semantic Approach to Explaining and Debugging Neural Network Based Object Detectors
arxiv-1912-00289.creator: Edward Kim, Gopinath, Divya, Corina Pasareanu, Sanjit A. Seshia
arxiv-1912-00289.description: Abstract Even as deep neural networks have become very effective for tasks in vision and perception, it remains difficult to explain and debug their behavior. In this paper, we present a programmatic and semantic approach to explaining, understanding, and debugging the correct and incorrect behaviors of a neural network-based perception system.

arxiv-2112-01629.title: Engineering AI Tools for Systematic and Scalable Quality Assessment in Magnetic Resonance Imaging
arxiv-2112-01629.creator: Yukai Zou, Ikbeom Jang
arxiv-2112-01629.description: Abstract A desire to achieve large medical imaging datasets keeps increasing as machine learning algorithms, parallel computing, and hardware technology evolve. Accordingly, there is a growing demand in pooling data from multiple clinical and academic institutes to enable large-scale clinical or translational research studies. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a frequently used, non-invasive imaging modality.

arxiv-2206-07634.title: Real3D-Aug: Point Cloud Augmentation by Placing Real Objects with Occlusion Handling for 3D Detection and Segmentation
arxiv-2206-07634.creator: Petr Šebek, Šimon Pokorný, Patrik Vacek, Tomáš SvobodaDept. of Cybernetics, Faculty of Electrical Engineering, Czech Technical University in Prague
arxiv-2206-07634.description: Abstract Object detection and semantic segmentation with the 3D lidar point cloud data require expensive annotation. We propose a data augmentation method that takes advantage of already annotated data multiple times. We propose an augmentation framework that reuses real data, automatically finds suitable placements in the scene to be augmented, and handles occlusions explicitly.

arxiv-2208-05043.title: A table of Legendre-transformation pairs with methodologies for construction, authentication, and approximation of pairs
arxiv-2208-05043.creator: Quinn T. Kolt, Steven J. Kilner, David L. Farnsworth
arxiv-2208-05043.description: Abstract An extensive table of pairs of functions linked by the Legendre transformation is presented. Many special functions and formulas that are used in the sciences are included in the pairs. Formulations are provided for finding the Legendre transformations of analytic functions and of polynomial approximations to other functions.

arxiv-2212-13157.title: Gaussian Process Classification Bandits
arxiv-2212-13157.creator: Tatsuya Hayashi, Naoki Ito, Koji Tabata, Atsuyoshi Nakamura, Katsumasa Fujita, Yoshinori Harada, Tamiki Komatsuzaki
arxiv-2212-13157.description: Abstract Classification bandits are multi-armed bandit problems whose task is to classify a given set of arms into either positive or negative class depending on whether the rate of the arms with the expected reward of at least h h is not less than w w for given thresholds h h and w w .

arxiv-2303-15642.title: Graph Sequence Learning for Premise Selection
arxiv-2303-15642.creator: Edvard K. Holden, Konstantin Korovin
arxiv-2303-15642.description: Abstract Premise selection is crucial for large theory reasoning as the sheer size of the problems quickly leads to resource starvation. This paper proposes a premise selection approach inspired by the domain of image captioning, where language models automatically generate a suitable caption for a given image.

arxiv-2304-05895.title: Towards Understanding How Data Augmentation Works with Imbalanced Data
arxiv-2304-05895.creator: Damien A. Dablain and Nitesh V. Chawla
arxiv-2304-05895.description: Abstract Data augmentation forms the cornerstone of many modern machine learning training pipelines; yet, the mechanisms by which it works are not clearly understood. Much of the research on data augmentation (DA) has focused on improving existing techniques, examining its regularization effects in the context of neural network over-fitting, or investigating its impact on features.

arxiv-2311-16721.title: Analytic solution of Markovian epidemics without re-infections on heterogeneous networks
arxiv-2311-16721.creator: Massimo A. Achterberg, Piet Van Mieghem
arxiv-2311-16721.description: Abstract Most epidemic processes on networks can be modelled by a compartmental model, that specifies the spread of a disease in a population. The corresponding compartmental graph describes how the viral state of the nodes (individuals) changes from one compartment to another. If the compartmental graph does not contain directed cycles (e.g.

arxiv-2407-15494.title: On the Particle Approximation of Lagged Feynman-Kac Formulae
arxiv-2407-15494.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . In this paper we examine the numerical approximation of the limiting invariant measure associated with Feynman-Kac formulae. These are expressed in a discrete time formulation and are associated with a Markov chain and a potential function. The typical application considered here is the computation of eigenvalues associated with non-negative operators as found, for example, in physics or particle simulation of rare-events.

arxiv-2502-02317.title: SpinGlassPEPS.jl: Tensor-network package for Ising-like optimization on quasi-two-dimensional graphs Journal: SoftwareX
arxiv-2502-02317.creator: Tomasz Śmierzchalski, Anna M. Dziubyna, Konrad Jałowiecki, Zakaria Mzaouali, Łukasz Pawela, Bartłomiej Gardas, Marek M. Rams
arxiv-2502-02317.description: Abstract This work introduces SpinGlassPEPS.jl , a software package implemented in Julia, designed to find low-energy configurations of generalized Potts models, including Ising and QUBO problems, utilizing heuristic tensor network contraction algorithms on quasi-2D geometries. In particular, the package employs the Projected Entangled-Pairs States to approximate the Boltzmann distribution corresponding to the model’s cost function.

arxiv-2502-10888.title: Tensor parametric Hamiltonian operator inference
arxiv-2502-10888.creator: Arjun Vijaywargiya, Shane A. McQuarrie, Anthony Gruber
arxiv-2502-10888.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Arjun Vijaywargiya, Shane A. McQuarrie, Anthony Gruber. This work presents a tensorial approach to constructing data-driven reduced-order models corresponding to semi-discrete partial differential equations with canonical Hamiltonian structure. By expressing parameter-varying operators with affine dependence as contractions of a generalized parameter vector against a constant tensor, this method leverages the operator inference framework to capture parametric dependence in the learned reduced-order model via the solution to a convex, least-squares optimization problem.

arxiv-2601-05565.title: On consistency around a 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 cube and Q3 analogue of the lattice Boussinesq equation
arxiv-2601-05565.creator: Pengyu Sun, Cheng Zhang, Frank Nijhoff
arxiv-2601-05565.description: Abstract In this paper, we present two new aspects of lattice Boussinesq (BSQ) equations. First, we show that the lattice potential BSQ (lpBSQ) equation defined on a nine-point square lattice admits a natural extension of three-dimensional consistency to a 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 cube—a cubic sublattice consisting of 27 27 vertices.

pmc-10594307.title: Developing a statewide infection prevention program assessment service for dialysis settings using a six-sigma framework
pmc-10594307.creator: Chelsea Ludington, Renee Brum
pmc-10594307.description: Background: Due to the need for recurrent and direct access to the bloodstream, patients who require hemodialysis are at higher risk of developing healthcare-associated infections. Failure to assess gaps in systems and processes impedes the implementation of quality and performance improvement initiatives.

pmc-10654632.title: Full-lung simulations of mechanically ventilated lungs incorporating recruitment/derecruitment dynamics
pmc-10654632.creator: Haoran Ma, Hideki Fujioka, David Halpern, Jason H. T. Bates, Donald P. Gaver
pmc-10654632.description: This study developed and investigated a comprehensive multiscale computational model of a mechanically ventilated ARDS lung to elucidate the underlying mechanisms contributing to the development or prevention of VILI. This model is built upon a healthy lung model that incorporates realistic airway and alveolar geometry, tissue distensibility, and surfactant dynamics.

pmc-11506345.title: Customized 3D-Printed Mesh, Membrane, Bone Substitute, and Dental Implant Applied to Guided Bone Regeneration in Oral Implantology: A Narrative Review
pmc-11506345.creator: Federica Di Spirito, Francesco Giordano, Maria Pia Di Palo, Cosimo Ferraro, Luigi Cecere, Eugenio Frucci, Mario Caggiano, Roberto Lo Giudice, Fawad Javed
pmc-11506345.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: The new frontiers of computer-based surgery, technology, and material advances, have allowed for customized 3D printed manufacturing to become widespread in guided bone regeneration (GBR) in oral implantology. The shape, structural, mechanical, and biological manufacturing characteristics achieved through 3D printing technologies allow for the customization of implant-prosthetic rehabilitations and GBR procedures according to patient-specific needs, reducing complications and surgery time.

pmc-12412388.title: Innovative Development of Research Engagement Manual: Strategies to Enhance Recruitment and Retention of Black Individuals in Clinical Trials for Substance Use Disorders
pmc-12412388.creator: Geoffrey Obel, DeWanda Harris-Trimiar, Joshua S. Elmore, Taryn L. Mayes, Adrienne Mays, Angela Casey-Willingham, Srividya Vasu, Steven Shoptaw, Madhukar H. Trivedi
pmc-12412388.description: Background:The participation of Black individuals in clinical trials remains lower than that of other racial and ethnic groups. Substance abuse adds additional barriers to recruitment and retention. While significant attention has been devoted to identifying barriers to recruitment/retention, efforts have been largely unsuccessful in increasing the participation of Black individuals in clinical trials.

pmc-12548982.title: Short-term variations in summer temperatures and mental health-related emergency department visits in Ontario, Canada
pmc-12548982.creator: Shaainee Ramnawaz, Eric Lavigne, Jura Augustinavicius, Scott Weichenthal
pmc-12548982.description: Background:The acute effects of summer temperatures on mental health are not yet fully understood, particularly with respect to potential effect modifiers.Methods:We conducted a time-stratified case-crossover study to examine the association between daily variations in summer ambient and apparent temperatures and the risk of emergency department (ED) visits for mental health outcomes Ontario, Canada, from 2004 and 2019.

pmc-12658393.title: Analyzing Instagram Food and Nutrition Posts Through a Food Literacy Lens: Content Analysis of Instagram Posts
pmc-12658393.creator: Yalinie Kulandaivelu, Jill Hamilton, Ananya Banerjee, Anatoliy Gruzd, Jennifer Stinson, Naomi Cahill, Sophie Desroches, Patricia Henriques
pmc-12658393.description: BackgroundDietary behaviors are directly linked to health and well-being. Food literacy education may improve poor dietary behaviors and thus, health and well-being. Social media is a popular source of food literacy education through content delivered by influencers and experts alike.

pmc-13080687.title: Aflatoxin B1 Impairs TACE Efficacy Through Downregulated Carbonic Anhydrase 2: A Bioinformatics Analysis
pmc-13080687.creator: Pengsheng Zhang, Yuyun Tong, Xiran Feng, Qi Lan, Jiaping Wang, Zhijie Xu
pmc-13080687.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is one of the leading causes of cancer‐related mortality worldwide, and transcatheter arterial chemoembolization (TACE) remains the core locoregional therapeutic modality for patients with intermediate to advanced disease. However, a considerable proportion of patients exhibit nonresponse to this treatment, which highlights an urgent need to identify reliable predictive biomarkers and elucidate the underlying mechanisms.

pmc-13507955.title: The effect of ultrasound-guided lung recruitment maneuvers on postoperative atelectasis: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-13507955.creator: Yilu Bao, Honghang Lin, Bo Tang, Kai Zhang, Biyun Chen
pmc-13507955.description: BackgroundPostoperative atelectasis is common after general anesthesia. Lung ultrasound may help individualize recruitment maneuvers, but the certainty and generalizability of the evidence remain uncertain.MethodsWe searched PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library through March 25, 2026 for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) of intraoperative ultrasound-guided lung recruitment maneuvers in adults undergoing elective surgery.

pmc-13700398.title: The potential of ruxolitinib as a senomorphic therapy in alleviating neovascular age-related macular degeneration
pmc-13700398.creator: Yinhao Wang, Zhihua Huang, Yulin Tseng, Huiling Ma, Kuangqi Chen, Xinlei Pan, Hui Ye, Tiantian Cheng, Jiayun Ge, Jingcheng Deng, Xinglin Wang, Jianhua Xia, Jianqin Shen, Chixin Du, Wei Lei, Zebin Mao, Hongguang Cui, Yan Sheng
pmc-13700398.description: BackgroundCellular senescence plays a key role in the pathogenesis of neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD). Senomorphic therapy, which targets the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), holds promise for treating age-related diseases; however, effective senomorphic treatments for nAMD remain lacking.MethodsWe screened a panel of senomorphic agents in bleomycin- and ionizing radiation (IR)-induced senescent ARPE-19 cells to identify a lead compound for nAMD.

uslaw-usc-t25-s292c.title: 25 U.S.C. § 292c — Unavailability of appropriated funds for boarding schools
uslaw-usc-t25-s292c.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s292c.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 7 (Education Of Indians). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. On and after October 12, 1984, no part of any appropriations to the Bureau of Indian Affairs under this or any other Act shall be available to continue academic and residential programs of the Chilocco, Seneca, Concho, and Fort Sill boarding schools, Oklahoma; Mount Edgecumbe boarding.

uslaw-usc-t54-s302904.title: 54 U.S.C. § 302904 — Direct grants for the preservation of properties included on National Register
uslaw-usc-t54-s302904.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t54-s302904.description: United States Code, Title 54 (National Park Service And Related Programs); Chapter 3029 (Grants). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Administration of Program.— The Secretary shall administer a program of direct grants for the preservation of properties included on the National Register. (b) Available Amount.— Funds to support the program annually shall not exceed 10 percent of the amount appropriated annually for.
